stem:
Aisha shines a lamp on a globe to model the Sun and Earth. One half of the globe is lit while the other half is dark.

Which claim correctly explains day and night on Earth?

options.text: Earth's rotation moves each place into and out of the side facing the Sun.
It is daytime everywhere on Earth at the same time.
Day and night are caused by Earth orbiting the Sun once each year.
Earth's rotation keeps every place facing the Sun at all times.

teacher.key_rationale: The lit side facing the Sun has day; rotation carries places into and out of that side. Day is not everywhere at once, and yearly orbit is not the cause of day and night.
